acceptance_signals: agentgov review release accepts --freshness-record only together with an explicit --freshness-as-of date; the record must be a regular file inside the selected source repository and is never modified.
When supplied, the existing Evidence Freshness checker result is written to a strict portable evidence-freshness sidecar and rendered in a clearly labeled non-blocking REVIEW.md section.
PASS, WARN, FAIL, ADVISORY, and NOT_APPLICABLE freshness results leave the existing release-review gates, review_state, human-decision state, and CLI exit behavior unchanged.

The pilot sidecar records the repository-relative record reference, evidence identity, explicit as-of date, status, reason codes, messages, and all-false/non-authorizing boundaries without raw source content or absolute paths.

Missing, outside-source, symbolic-link, malformed-JSON, or invalid-date freshness inputs fail atomically as operational errors and create no review bundle; no automatic event discovery or observed-event mutation is introduced.
Focused tests cover all freshness statuses, unchanged blocking semantics, paired CLI inputs, portable bundle output, strict schema, Markdown rendering, and current behavior without optional inputs.

Release-review and Evidence Freshness documentation, strategic development state, current status, and session evidence describe the pilot honestly and distinguish it from the published 0.3.0rc1 release.
The supported Python 3.11 suite, task/repository governance, scope reconciliation, privacy scan, and diff validation pass or record pre-existing unrelated findings.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-7441a2fdb36542b9ada70c4a1be58d9b and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Extend agentgov review release with optional Evidence Freshness inputs so one source-repository record is checked at an explicit as-of date and written into the create-new-only release review bundle as a separate advisory sidecar and Markdown section, while leaving release-review gates, review_state, exit behavior, human decision, and authority boundaries unchanged.

items: Mixing advisory freshness with deterministic release gates could accidentally block or approve a release.
Recording an absolute freshness path would make the bundle non-portable and leak host-local information.
Copying raw source content into the sidecar would violate the reference-only privacy boundary.
Changing the published release-review 1.0 contract would create unnecessary compatibility risk for a bounded pilot.
Pre-existing prior-task and user-owned working-copy changes must remain outside this task.
Reviewed assumption: A separate sidecar plus REVIEW.md section is the smallest pilot and avoids changing the existing strict release-review 1.0 JSON contract.
Reviewed assumption: The current repository-owned 0.3.0rc1 compatibility-baseline freshness record is the first real source record used by the pilot.
Reviewed assumption: Freshness semantic FAIL is non-blocking in this pilot; inability to read or evaluate the requested input is an operational error that prevents partial bundle creation.
Reviewed assumption: Observed events remain producer-supplied facts already present in the record.
Reviewed assumption: The user-selected direction and resolved alignment journey authorize proposing this task but do not grant Git, release, publication, or deployment authority.
Reviewed unknown: Whether release reviewers find the added sidecar useful in routine work remains unknown until an actual bundle is reviewed.
Reviewed unknown: Whether Evidence Freshness should later influence release gates remains explicitly undecided.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the pilot should later extend to consumer CI or upgrade review remains undecided.

title: Pilot non-blocking Evidence Freshness in release review
